reasonLiveSkipped: live exams schema lacks import/version/workflow/QC tables

importValidation.description: JSON and CSV payloads parse and validate with 0 errors; sections knowledge/reading/listening detected.

fullLifecycle.description: import -> reading passage/audio -> publish blocked while draft -> review -> approved -> published -> published listing -> mock exam load -> timer -> JLPT scoring -> mistake vault -> skill matrix -> export JSON/CSV -> rollback.

csvImport.description: CSV import persists the same question count as JSON.

aiDraft.description: AI draft questions are marked is_published=false, validate cleanly, and import as drafts.

versionRevert.description: Version snapshot v1 plus a later import, then revertToVersion restores the v1 question set.

rollbackGuards.description: Rollback requires explicit admin confirmation and an admin actor.

defects.summary: CSV header normalization lowercases headers, so the generated `correctAnswer` column became `correctanswer` and was never read; the app's own CSV template failed validation with 'correctAnswer ko'rsatilmagan'.
defects.fix: Read lowercased `correctanswer` fallback in the CSV record mapper.
defects.regressionCoverage: CSV import validation + CSV full-exam import for N3/N2/N1

qualityGates.fullSuite: 2211/2211 pass (243 passed, 1 skipped); all timeouts resolved in Task 21

limitations: Runs against an in-memory Supabase fake, not the live project; RLS, storage, and real network behavior are not exercised.
AI extraction uses a deterministic mocked provider response.
Content is sampled (9 questions/level) from the repository dataset, not a full production question bank.
